scripts.description: Create HIGH incident, OPEN action and link through real operation

steps.parameters_sql: SELECT @ij AS job_id,@it AS reporter_id,'2026-10-30' AS incident_date,'QUALITY' AS incident_type,'HIGH' AS severity,'IA synthetic incident' AS incident_description,@it AS assigned_staff_id,'IA synthetic action' AS action_description,'2026-10-31' AS due_date
steps.verification_sql: SELECT IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Incident i JOIN IncidentCorrectiveAction l ON l.incident_id=i.incident_id JOIN CorrectiveAction a ON a.action_id=l.action_id WHERE i.incident_id=@op_incident_id AND i.job_id=@ij AND i.severity='HIGH' AND i.incident_status='OPEN' AND a.action_id=@op_action_id AND a.assigned_staff_id=@it AND a.action_status='OPEN' AND a.created_date='2026-10-30' AND a.due_date='2026-10-31' AND a.resolved_date IS NULL AND a.resolution_note IS NULL AND a.verified_by_manager_id IS NULL AND a.verified_date IS NULL)=1,'PASS','FAIL') AS result

cases.requirement: Create HIGH incident, OPEN action and link through real operation
cases.initial_state: Isolated IA fixture from script; no concurrent writes; all fixture tables transactional
cases.expected_result: Each real operation succeeds and every step postcondition passes; outer rollback restores full baseline

scripts.description: Rollback incident inserted before corrective-action constraint failure

steps.parameters_sql: SELECT @ij AS job_id,@it AS reporter_id,'2026-10-30' AS incident_date,'QUALITY' AS incident_type,'HIGH' AS severity,'IA synthetic incident' AS incident_description,@it AS assigned_staff_id,'   ' AS action_description,'2026-10-31' AS due_date
steps.failure_verification_sql: SELECT IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Incident WHERE job_id=@ij)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CorrectiveAction WHERE assigned_staff_id=@it)=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IncidentCorrectiveAction l JOIN Incident i ON i.incident_id=l.incident_id WHERE i.job_id=@ij)=0,'PASS','FAIL') AS result

cases.requirement: Rollback incident inserted before corrective-action constraint failure

cases.expected_result: Validation passes; incident exists when action INSERT fails with 3819/HY000; rollback removes all partial operation writes; outer rollback restores full baseline
